interface.signature: def check(N: int, M: int, Edges: List[List[int]]) -> bool:

preconditions.expression: 1 <= N <= 10 and 1 <= M <= 15 and all(len(edge) == 2 for edge in Edges) and all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N for edge in Edges for u, v in [edge])
preconditions.description: N is the number of vertices (1 ≤ N ≤ 10), M is the number of edges (1 ≤ M ≤ 15), and each edge is a pair of distinct vertices within the range [1, N].

postconditions.expression: return_value == any(all(vertex in path for vertex in range(1, N + 1)) and all((path[i], path[i + 1]) in {(u, v), (v, u) for u, v in Edges} for i in range(len(path) - 1)) for path in permutations(range(1, N + 1)))
postconditions.description: The function returns true if and only if there exists a permutation of vertices (path) such that every consecutive pair of vertices in the path is connected by an edge in the graph, and all vertices are included exactly once.
